title: (News Focus) Hyundai Motor steps up physical AI push amid Chinese competition, stock slump
caption:
Hyundai saw its valuation soar after showing off humanoid robots, but mounting losses tell a different story. Facing intense pressure from low-cost Chinese automakers, the company is pivoting from futuristic prototypes to practical AI on the assembly floor.
